mapper.insert: INSERT INTO llm_call_log (request_id, app_key, provider, model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, cost_usd, latency_ms, status, error_message, created_at) VALUES (#{requestId}, #{appKey}, #{provider}, #{model}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{totalTokens}, #{costUsd}, #{latencyMs}, #{status}, #{errorMessage}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT DATE(created_at) AS date, SUM(total_tokens) AS totalTokens, SUM(cost_usd) AS totalCost, COUNT(*) AS callCount FROM llm_call_log WHERE created_at BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY date
